summary: docs/PLAYER_DATA.md generated from src/ by tools/build-player-data-doc.mjs: every localStorage key, what it holds, who owns it, and what a player sees when a write fails

coordination.notes: Follows tools/build-crossing-build-list.mjs: prose authored in the generator, every figure derived at generation time, a floor that refuses to publish from a truncated scan. That generator has no --check of its own (tools/crossing-build-list-test.mjs re-derives instead); this one carries --check because the question is the generator's own comparison, which is what the increment's verify line asks for. tools/test-suites.json was added to the touches list: E6 named package.json only, and a suite registered in one place never runs (plan trap 2).

findings.what: Nothing in src/ calls localStorage.setItem directly
findings.judgement: Checked, not assumed. Every write goes through src/lib/storage.ts, so the doc can give one answer to 'what happens on quota failure' instead of one per key. The only non-JSON writes are writeText for the two plain-number settings (window-fraction sizes and the attach port).

findings.what: drc.map-height.v1 is read but never written
findings.judgement: It is the superseded key, read once to migrate a genuine v1 customisation. Recorded as such in the doc rather than listed as if it were live.
